subject: Planning: platform demo — VP/CIO presence & recording preference
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire@vectora.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: victor.ruiz@vectora.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo — aligning on VP/CIO attendance

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Vectora is excited to see Redwood’s serving platform in action. Our execs (VP Product — myself, and CIO — Victor) want to join the demo for a 30–40 minute look at performance profiles, routing/fallback, and the dedicated/private deployment options.

High-level asks:
- Can the demo surface latency and cost tradeoffs for a 1k rps synthetic workload?
- We’d like to understand southern-eu region routing (we have infra in FRA).
- Strong preference for an exec-level walkthrough first 10 minutes, then a short Q&A.

Are you able to confirm a slot next week where VP/CIO can attend? We are flexible on Tuesday/Wednesday mornings PT. Also — Vectora prefers the session recorded for internal review; let us know if that’s a problem.

Attaching a short product brief so you have context.

Best,
Claire Hsu
VP Product, Vectora Systems
Attachments: Vectora_MVP_Rundown.pdf

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire@vectora.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — aligning on VP/CIO attendance

Claire — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the brief.

We can absolutely focus the first 10–12 minutes on an exec-level summary (latency/cost highlights + routing), then drop into a live demo with the synthetic load and the routing fallback examples. Recording is fine — we’ll share a trimmed recording and the runbook.

Availability:
- Tue 2026-05-20, 09:00–09:50 PT (ours preferred)
- Wed 2026-05-21, 10:00–10:45 PT

Quick operational notes: can you confirm whether Victor needs deeper questions on KMS/HSM integrations (we can bring our security engineer for that section) and whether the FRA region routing is for production traffic or a proof-of-concept? That helps us pick the backend variants to demo.

I’ll loop in Rishi and Marcus to confirm who will present which segment and to nominate a backup exec if something shifts.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
